featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie says this year brought a clear jump in model capability: instead of telling agents precisely what to do, it's now better to hand them problems you can't easily define yourself. A year ago you had to spell out exactly how to design and build a product idea or there was almost no chance of success; now the agent can connect dots across a far larger solution space and often produces a better implementation than you would have thought of. He expects this to hold across nearly every domain of knowle…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为，今年模型能力出现了一次明显跃迁：与其精确告诉 Agent「怎么做」，不如把那些你自己都难以清晰定义的问题直接交给它。一年前，想让 Agent 设计和开发你的产品构想，必须把实现路径讲得非常清楚，否则几乎不可能成功；现在 Agent 能在远比人更大的解空间里「连点成线」，往往能给出比你自己想到的更好的实现。他判断这一点会在几乎所有知识工作领域成立，金融、法律、生命科学、网络安全等都会感受到冲击。另一条推文他只说了一句「今天会是数学界的大日子」。

featured.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
featured.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad noted that two separate Riemann proofs — one by AI and one by a human — are coming out at the same time. Assuming both are correct, he says it will be interesting to compare them, especially on elegance. He also posted a one-liner: "Is it a bear market?"
featured.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 关注到黎曼猜想同时出现了两份证明——一份来自 AI，一份来自人类。他说，假设两者都正确，最有意思的是比较二者的差异，尤其是在「优雅程度」上。另外他还发了一句「这是熊市吗？」。

featured.title: Scaling Linear's GTM to $100M ARR — Cristina Cordova, COO
featured.summaryEn: Linear COO Cristina Cordova explains how a PLG tool known as "the startup issue tracker" moved upmarket, and how — after declaring "issue tracking is dead" — Linear repositioned itself as a product development system for the agent era, where over 50% of issues are now created by agents. Cordova joined Linear about three and a half years ago at roughly 40 people, after leading platform/APIs and partnerships at Notion and seven and a half years of early partnerships and GTM at Stripe. She says not every company needs a COO — only when founders look at a function and don't know what great looks like or how to get there. Her work trial was the real job: a 6–12 month GTM plan. items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: South Park Commons GP and former Dropbox CTO Aditya Agarwal quipped: we're solving Riemann and crushing pancreatic cancer with a pill, but sure, let's debate whether the "AI trade" is good. He also promoted SPC India's Nov 25 event, citing Unit21 (started at SPC in 2018, has since caught $14B+ in financial crime) and Zumutor (founded in 2013 on the belief that new cancer drugs would be discovered in India).
items.insightZh: South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO Aditya Agarwal 吐槽：我们正在解决黎曼猜想，还在用一颗药丸攻克胰腺癌，结果大家还在争论「AI 交易」到底好不好。另外他为 SPC India 11 月 25 日的活动拉人：Unit21 创始人 2018 年在 SPC 创业，至今已拦截超过 140 亿美元的金融犯罪；Zumutor 创始人 2013 年创业时就相信新的抗癌药会在印度被发现。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch posted twice. First: his "hello world" on an early internal build of @eve was a personal shopper agent — it worked, but much infrastructure was missing. Now @agentcardhq exists, models are better, eve's iMessage and WhatsApp channels are mature, and performance is vastly improved without trading off durability or encryption, so you can ship a Muse/Instinct-caliber platform you fully control on Vercel's open intelligence stack — he recommends starting from the template. Second: Vercel's A…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 发了两条。第一，他第一次试用 @eve 内部预发布版本时，「个人导购 Agent」就是他的 hello world——当时能跑，但很多基础设施缺失；如今有了 @agentcardhq，模型更强，eve 的 iMessage 和 WhatsApp 渠道已成熟，性能大幅提升（且没有牺牲持久性和加密），可以在 Vercel 的开放智能栈上做出 Muse / Instinct 级别、完全自控的平台，并推荐大家直接用模板起步。第二，Vercel 的 AI 基础设施拿到了 ISO 42001:2023 认证，他称之为「AI 领域的 SOC2」——首个由第三方独立审计、覆盖 AI 系统构建、评估、监控与治理的全球标准，每年审计一次。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux (Codex & ChatGPT) announced a desktop app upgrade: faster, simpler and much more pleasant to use, with the team "locked in." He also joked that they inadvertently built an internal experience so fun that everyone is playing instead of working.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 宣布桌面应用升级：更快、更简洁、用起来更舒服，团队「全员锁死在做这件事」。他还半开玩笑说团队内部「不小心」做出了一个过于好玩的体验，现在大家都在玩而不是工作。

items.title: Nan Yu · OpenAI Codex 产品、前 Linear 产品负责人
items.summaryEn: OpenAI Codex product lead (ex-Linear head of product) Nan Yu said the latest update brings big performance and quality-of-life wins for the actions you do dozens to hundreds of times a day.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 产品、前 Linear 产品负责人 Nan Yu 表示，这次更新针对的是那些每天要做几十到上百次的操作，带来了显著的性能和体验改进。

items.title: Josh Woodward · Google Labs / Gemini App VP
items.summaryEn: Google Labs / Gemini App VP Josh Woodward said it was a big week of shipping. On the Friday afternoon before the holiday week, a few of them were having fun with Gemini Neon, loved a post from @UFO2002616, and simply built the idea and shipped it to prod — long-click the model picker on the web to try it.
items.insightZh: Google Labs / Gemini App VP Josh Woodward 说这周发布密集。节前周五下午，几个人在玩 Gemini Neon，看到用户 @UFO2002616 的一条帖子很喜欢，就直接把那个想法做出来上线了——在网页端长按模型选择器即可体验。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials creator Peter Yang shared a tip for those trying @antigravity for Neon: open the linked page, tap "see more," then the share button, then "Add to Home Screen" — and you can talk to all your Antigravity threads via remote control on mobile. Even without a mobile app (yet), he finds Antigravity's remote control better than Claude's because all threads are available by default.
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 给用 @antigravity 跑 Neon 的人一个小技巧：打开指定页面，点「查看更多」再点分享，选择「添加到主屏幕」，就能在手机上通过远程控制访问所有 Antigravity 会话。他认为虽然 Antigravity 还没有移动 App，但它的远程控制比 Claude 的更好用，因为所有会话默认都可访问。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder
items.summaryEn: Builder Zara Zhang advised: don't send clients Claude Artifacts or ChatGPT-generated sites — it makes them feel "I could have just prompted Claude/Codex myself." She also posted: "If you curate, you should create."
items.insightZh: Builder Zara Zhang 给做客户服务的人一条提醒：不要把 Claude Artifacts / ChatGPT 生成的网站直接发给客户，这会让对方觉得「我自己去 prompt Claude/Codex 不就行了」。她另一句短评是：如果你在做策展，你也应该去创作。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark Capital VC
items.summaryEn: FirstMark VC Matt Turck shared a story of automated agentic emailing vs. the real world: at Slush, someone emailed him twice to meet, he replied once, then got three more emails in rapid succession. When they bumped into each other later, the guy read his name tag twice, looked blank, clearly had no idea who he was, said "oh hi" and walked away.
items.insightZh: FirstMark Capital VC Matt Turck 讲了一个「自动化 Agent 邮件 vs 现实世界」的故事：在 Slush 大会上，有人发了两封邮件约他见面，他回了一封，对方又接连发了三封；当天两人偶遇，他说「看来是缘分」，对方盯着他的胸牌看了两遍，一脸茫然，显然不知道他是谁，说了句「哦，嗨」就走了。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / smol.ai
items.summaryEn: Latent Space's Swyx previewed an upcoming piece on why @j_schottenstein left dbt for LangChain to help build it into a $3B startup — and why they now have to reinvent the content, context (knowledge) and software factory from scratch. He also asked what happened to Cursor's origin: is anyone using it in anger, and does it have actions/CI/CD yet?
items.insightZh: Latent Space 主理人 Swyx 预告了一期内容：@j_schottenstein 为什么离开 dbt 加入 LangChain 并参与把它做成 30 亿美元的创业公司，以及他们如今为何要从零重新构建内容、上下文（知识）和软件工厂。他还追问 Cursor 的 origin 功能后来怎么样了，有没有人真正重度使用、是否已经支持 actions/CI/CD。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Y Combinator President & CEO Garry Tan weighed in on California tax policy: you don't need an asset seizure tax — you need to encourage building new ideas and startups in California, and a government that spends wisely on things that help people. He argues the ivory-tower academics and union bosses have it wrong.
items.insightZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO Garry Tan 就加州税收辩论表态：不需要「资产没收税」，需要的是鼓励人们在加州创造新想法、创办新公司，再由政府把钱明智地花在真正帮助民众的事上；他认为象牙塔学者和工会领袖的思路是错的。
